title: Cooing, sounds like oooo and aahh, is a 4-month CDC item
summary: By 4 months, most babies coo, making sounds like oooo and aahh, on the CDC language list.
body: The CDC 4-month page puts cooing in the language and communication list: makes sounds like oooo and aahh. The page's heading is what most babies do by 4 months. Cooing here is vowel-like sound, not a word and not the repeated syllables that show up on the 9-month page. A baby who is not yet making those vowels has not been given a diagnosis by this line. The age is the United States CDC mark.

sources.title: Milestones by 4 Months
sources.author: Centers for Disease Control and Prevention
sources.note: US federal page, public domain. Opened 2026-11-26. Reviewed date on the page is 16 May 2026. Supports the language milestone that most babies make sounds like oooo and aahh, labeled cooing.
